examples.en: The first phase of the project will finish in March.
examples.zh: 這個專案的第一階段將在三月完成。

examples.en: Many teenagers go through a phase of wanting to be alone.
examples.zh: 許多青少年會經歷一段想要獨處的時期。

examples.en: The moon moves through several phases each month.
examples.zh: 月亮每個月會經歷數種月相變化。

examples.en: The bus company offers a free pickup from the airport.
examples.zh: 這家巴士公司提供免費接機服務。

examples.en: You can arrange a pickup time when you place the order.
examples.zh: 下訂單時，你可以約定取貨時間。

examples.en: My uncle drives a red pickup to his farm every morning.
examples.zh: 我叔叔每天早上開一輛紅色小貨車去他的農場。

examples.en: We walked along the pier and watched the boats come in.
examples.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，看著船隻進港。

examples.en: The restaurant at the end of the pier serves fresh fish.
examples.zh: 碼頭盡頭的餐廳供應新鮮的魚。

examples.en: Workers are repairing the concrete pier under the bridge.
examples.zh: 工人正在修補橋下的水泥橋墩。

examples.en: Two tall stone pillars stand at the entrance of the temple.
examples.zh: 兩根高大的石柱矗立在寺廟入口。

examples.en: Honesty is one of the pillars of a good friendship.
examples.zh: 誠實是良好友誼的支柱之一。

examples.en: Mrs. Lin is a pillar of our community.
examples.zh: 林太太是我們社區的中堅分子。

examples.en: A long pipeline carries water from the mountains to the city.
examples.zh: 一條長長的管線把水從山上送往城市。

examples.en: The company has several new products in the pipeline.
examples.zh: 這家公司有好幾項新產品正在籌備中。

examples.en: Workers found a leak in the gas pipeline near the school.
examples.zh: 工人在學校附近的瓦斯管線發現漏氣。

examples.en: The pitcher threw the ball straight to the catcher.
examples.zh: 投手把球直直投向捕手。

examples.en: Please put a pitcher of water on the table.
examples.zh: 請在桌上放一壺水。

examples.en: She is the best pitcher on our school baseball team.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校棒球隊最棒的投手。

examples.en: The mayor ignored the neighbors' plea for a new bus stop.
examples.zh: 市長沒有理會鄰居們要求增設公車站的請求。

examples.en: He made a plea for help when his car broke down.
examples.zh: 他的車拋錨時，他開口懇求協助。

examples.en: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty in court.
examples.zh: 被告在法庭上提出無罪答辯。

examples.en: The little boy pleaded with his mother to buy the toy.
examples.zh: 小男孩央求媽媽買那個玩具。

examples.en: She pleaded for more time to finish the report.
examples.zh: 她懇求多給一點時間完成報告。

examples.en: The manager pleaded guilty to fraud during the court hearing.
examples.zh: 經理在法院審理時承認詐欺罪。

examples.en: The students took a pledge to keep the park clean.
examples.zh: 學生們許下誓言要維護公園的整潔。

examples.en: The company made a pledge to use less plastic.
examples.zh: 這家公司承諾要減少塑膠的使用。

examples.en: Her pledge of one thousand dollars helped the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她承諾捐出一千元，幫助了動物收容所。

examples.en: I pledge to do my best in every class this year.
examples.zh: 我保證今年每一堂課都盡全力。

examples.en: Many parents pledged money for the new library.
examples.zh: 許多家長承諾捐款給新圖書館。

examples.en: The team pledged to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 團隊承諾會準時完成專案。

examples.en: The children plunged into the pool on a hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎熱的午後，孩子們紛紛跳進泳池。

examples.en: Prices plunged after the store began its summer sale.
examples.zh: 商店開始夏季特賣後，價格大幅下降。

examples.en: He plunged himself into his studies before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前，他全心投入課業。

examples.en: There was a sudden plunge in the price of vegetables.
examples.zh: 蔬菜價格突然暴跌。

examples.en: She took a plunge into the cold lake.
examples.zh: 她跳進了冰冷的湖裡。

examples.en: The company's sales took a plunge last winter.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年冬天的銷售量驟降。

examples.en: She wrote a poetic description of the sunset.
examples.zh: 她寫了一段富有詩意的夕陽描寫。

examples.en: The old village has a quiet and poetic charm.
examples.zh: 這座古老的村莊有一種寧靜而富詩意的魅力。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to use poetic language in the essay.
examples.zh: 老師要我們在作文中使用富有詩意的語言。

examples.en: Don't poke the fish with your finger.
examples.zh: 不要用手指去戳那條魚。

examples.en: He poked a hole in the paper with a pencil.
examples.zh: 他用鉛筆在紙上戳了一個洞。

examples.en: The puppy poked its head out of the box.
examples.zh: 小狗從箱子裡探出頭來。

examples.en: She gave her brother a poke in the arm.
examples.zh: 她戳了弟弟的手臂一下。

examples.en: A light poke woke the sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 輕輕一戳就把熟睡的貓叫醒了。

examples.en: Give the fire a poke so it burns better.
examples.zh: 撥一下火，讓它燒得更旺。

examples.en: We sat on the porch and drank iced tea.
examples.zh: 我們坐在門廊上喝冰紅茶。

examples.en: The package was left on the front porch.
examples.zh: 包裹被放在前門廊上。

examples.en: Grandpa likes reading the newspaper on the porch.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在門廊上看報紙。

senses.zh: 作品集；投資組合；公事包

examples.en: She showed her art portfolio to the college teacher.
examples.zh: 她把自己的美術作品集拿給大學老師看。

examples.en: My father keeps a balanced portfolio of stocks and bonds.
examples.zh: 我父親持有股票與債券平衡的投資組合。

examples.en: The designer carried a leather portfolio to the meeting.
examples.zh: 設計師帶著一只皮製公事包去開會。

examples.en: Dr. Chen is a medical practitioner with twenty years of experience.
examples.zh: 陳醫師是一位有二十年經驗的執業醫師。

examples.en: The workshop is open to legal practitioners and students.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊開放給法律從業人員和學生。

examples.en: She is a practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 她是一位傳統中醫的執業者。

examples.en: Wear a helmet as a precaution when you ride a bike.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車時，戴上安全帽是一種預防措施。

examples.en: The school took extra precautions during the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風期間，學校採取了額外的防範措施。

examples.en: We took the precaution of saving a copy of the file.
examples.zh: 我們事先備份了一份檔案以防萬一。

examples.en: The lion is a powerful predator on the African plains.
examples.zh: 獅子是非洲平原上強大的掠食者。

examples.en: Small birds hide in bushes to escape from predators.
examples.zh: 小鳥躲在灌木叢裡以躲避掠食者。

examples.en: The great white shark is a top predator in the ocean.
examples.zh: 大白鯊是海洋中的頂級掠食者。

examples.en: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?
examples.zh: 你比較喜歡茶還是咖啡？

examples.en: My preference is to travel by train rather than by plane.
examples.zh: 我比較喜歡搭火車旅行，而不是搭飛機。

examples.en: Parents with young children are given preference when seats are limited.
examples.zh: 座位有限時，帶幼兒的家長享有優先權。

examples.en: Prejudice against newcomers can hurt a community.
examples.zh: 對新來者的偏見可能傷害一個社區。

examples.en: The teacher taught us to face our own prejudices honestly.
examples.zh: 老師教我們誠實面對自己的偏見。

examples.en: He had a prejudice against people who talked too loudly.
examples.zh: 他對說話太大聲的人有成見。

examples.en: One bad review should not prejudice you against the book.
examples.zh: 不該因為一則負面評論就對這本書抱持偏見。

examples.en: The long delay may prejudice the company's chances.
examples.zh: 長時間的延誤可能損害這家公司的機會。

examples.en: Please don't let rumors prejudice your opinion of her.
examples.zh: 請不要讓謠言使你對她產生偏見。

examples.en: The preliminary results will be announced next week.
examples.zh: 初步結果將在下週公布。

examples.en: We held a preliminary meeting before the main event.
examples.zh: 我們在正式活動之前先召開了預備會議。

examples.en: Our team passed the preliminary round of the contest.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍通過了比賽的初賽。

examples.en: Please complete the preliminaries before the interview begins.
examples.zh: 請在面試開始前完成準備工作。

examples.en: She won her race in the preliminaries.
examples.zh: 她在預賽中贏得了自己那一組的比賽。

examples.en: After the usual preliminaries, we started the lesson.
examples.zh: 在例行的開場流程之後，我們開始上課。

examples.en: It is premature to decide before we see all the data.
examples.zh: 在看到所有資料前就做決定還太早。

examples.en: The baby was born premature and stayed in the hospital.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒是早產兒，出生後留在醫院。

examples.en: The team's premature celebration made them look foolish.
examples.zh: 球隊過早慶祝，讓他們顯得很傻。

examples.en: This is the premier art museum in the country.
examples.zh: 這是全國首屈一指的美術館。

examples.en: The premier event of the week is the school concert.
examples.zh: 本週最重要的活動是學校音樂會。

examples.en: She works for a premier law firm in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她任職於台北一家頂尖的律師事務所。

examples.en: The premier gave a speech about the new budget.
examples.zh: 總理發表了一場關於新預算的演說。

examples.en: The premier visited our school to talk with the students.
examples.zh: 總理造訪了我們的學校，與學生交談。

examples.en: Reporters asked the premier several questions about education.
examples.zh: 記者向總理提出了幾個關於教育的問題。

senses.zh: 前提；房屋及其用地（用複數）

examples.en: The whole plan is based on a false premise.
examples.zh: 整個計畫建立在一個錯誤的前提上。

examples.en: We accepted the premise that everyone would work hard.
examples.zh: 我們接受了大家都會努力工作的前提。

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed on the premises of the school.
examples.zh: 學校校園內禁止吸菸。

examples.en: We pay the insurance premium every month.
examples.zh: 我們每個月繳交保險費。

examples.en: You must pay a premium for tickets close to the stage.
examples.zh: 靠近舞台的票必須額外付費。

examples.en: Fresh fruit sells at a premium during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間新鮮水果的售價會有溢價。

examples.en: The shop sells premium coffee from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家店販售台灣出產的高級咖啡。

examples.en: Premium members can enter the lounge for free.
examples.zh: 高級會員可以免費進入貴賓室。

examples.en: They bought premium tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 他們買了這場音樂會的貴賓票。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine for my sore throat.
examples.zh: 醫生開了藥給我治喉嚨痛。

examples.en: The rules prescribe how the form should be filled out.
examples.zh: 規定中明訂了表格該如何填寫。

examples.en: The school prescribes a uniform for all students.
examples.zh: 學校規定所有學生都要穿制服。

examples.en: The doctor wrote a prescription for the allergy medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生開了過敏藥的處方箋。

examples.en: You need a prescription to buy this kind of medicine.
examples.zh: 購買這種藥需要處方箋。

examples.en: I took the prescription to the pharmacy near my house.
examples.zh: 我把處方箋拿到家附近的藥局。

senses.zh: 總統職位；總統任期；會長或社長職位

examples.en: She hopes to win the presidency of the student council.
examples.zh: 她希望當選學生會會長一職。

examples.en: The country grew stronger during his presidency.
examples.zh: 在他的總統任期內，這個國家變得更強盛。

examples.en: The presidency of the club changes hands every year.
examples.zh: 這個社團的社長職位每年輪替。

examples.en: The store is closed, presumably because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 商店沒有開，大概是因為假日。

examples.en: Presumably, you have already read the instructions.
examples.zh: 想必你已經讀過說明了。

examples.en: He is late, presumably stuck in traffic.
examples.zh: 他遲到了，大概是塞在車陣中。

examples.en: I presume you have already had lunch.
examples.zh: 我猜你已經吃過午餐了。

examples.en: We presumed that the meeting would start on time.
examples.zh: 我們原本以為會議會準時開始。

examples.en: Don't presume to speak for everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 不要擅自代表全班同學發言。

examples.en: Cool and rainy weather prevails in the north during winter.
examples.zh: 冬季北部盛行涼爽多雨的天氣。

examples.en: We hope that common sense will prevail in the end.
examples.zh: 我們希望常理最終能占上風。

examples.en: The belief that breakfast is important still prevails in many homes.
examples.zh: 許多家庭仍普遍相信早餐很重要。

examples.en: The eagle watched its prey from high in the sky.
examples.zh: 老鷹從高空盯著牠的獵物。

examples.en: Mice are common prey for owls.
examples.zh: 老鼠是貓頭鷹常見的獵物。

examples.en: The cat crouched low, waiting for its prey.
examples.zh: 貓壓低身子，等待牠的獵物。

examples.en: Owls prey on small animals at night.
examples.zh: 貓頭鷹在夜間捕食小動物。

examples.en: Some dishonest people prey on elderly customers.
examples.zh: 有些不誠實的人專門欺騙年長的顧客。

examples.en: Worry about the exam preyed on her mind all week.
examples.zh: 對考試的擔憂整個星期都折磨著她。

examples.en: You need prior permission to enter the lab.
examples.zh: 進入實驗室需要事先許可。

examples.en: I had a prior appointment, so I could not join the dinner.
examples.zh: 我先前已有約，所以無法參加晚餐。

examples.en: Prior experience is helpful but not required for this job.
examples.zh: 先前的經驗有幫助，但不是這份工作的必要條件。

examples.en: The principal proclaimed the start of the school festival.
examples.zh: 校長宣布校慶活動開始。

examples.en: The banner proclaims the opening of a new library.
examples.zh: 布條宣告新圖書館啟用。

examples.en: The mayor proclaimed a day of celebration for the city.
examples.zh: 市長宣布這座城市要有一天的慶祝活動。

examples.en: Good sleep can improve your productivity at work.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠能提高你的工作效率。

examples.en: The new software helped boost our productivity.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體幫助我們提升了生產力。

examples.en: A tidy desk may increase your productivity.
examples.zh: 整潔的書桌可能提高你的效率。

examples.en: Please upload a photo to your online profile.
examples.zh: 請在你的線上個人檔案中上傳一張照片。

examples.en: The artist drew a profile of the girl's face.
examples.zh: 畫家畫了女孩臉部的側面像。

examples.en: The newspaper ran a short profile of the new coach.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇新教練的簡介。

examples.en: The magazine profiled several young chefs this month.
examples.zh: 這份雜誌本月介紹了幾位年輕主廚。

examples.en: The article profiles a farmer who grows organic rice.
examples.zh: 這篇文章介紹了一位種植有機稻米的農夫。

examples.en: The program profiled the school's best athletes.
examples.zh: 這個節目介紹了學校最優秀的運動員。

examples.en: The book had a profound effect on her life.
examples.zh: 這本書對她的人生產生了深遠的影響。

examples.en: The teacher asked a profound question about honesty.
examples.zh: 老師提出了一個關於誠實的深刻問題。

examples.en: We felt a profound sadness when the old teacher left.
examples.zh: 那位老教師離開時，我們感到深深的悲傷。

examples.en: The projection shows sales will rise by ten percent.
examples.zh: 預測顯示銷售額將成長百分之十。

examples.en: The teacher used a projection of the map on the screen.
examples.zh: 老師在螢幕上投影了這張地圖。

examples.en: A small projection on the wall holds the lamp.
examples.zh: 牆上一個小小的突出物托著那盞燈。

examples.en: Heavy rain prolonged the trip by two hours.
examples.zh: 大雨讓旅程延長了兩小時。

examples.en: Don't prolong the meeting with unnecessary questions.
examples.zh: 不要用不必要的問題拖長會議。

examples.en: Regular exercise may help prolong your life.
examples.zh: 規律運動可能有助於延年益壽。

examples.en: This area is prone to floods in the summer.
examples.zh: 這個地區夏季容易淹水。

examples.en: Children are prone to catching colds in winter.
examples.zh: 小孩在冬天容易感冒。

examples.en: She lay prone on the mat during the stretching exercise.
examples.zh: 她在伸展運動時俯臥在墊子上。

examples.en: The poster was part of a propaganda campaign.
examples.zh: 這張海報是宣傳活動的一部分。

examples.en: Students learned how to spot propaganda in old newspapers.
examples.zh: 學生們學習如何辨認舊報紙中帶有偏向的宣傳。

examples.en: The old film was full of propaganda about the country.
examples.zh: 那部老電影充滿了關於這個國家的宣傳。

examples.en: The story tells of a prophet who warned the king.
examples.zh: 這個故事描述一位警告國王的先知。

examples.en: Many people called him a prophet of the new age.
examples.zh: 許多人稱他為新時代的預言家。

examples.en: The prophet in the old tale predicted a great flood.
examples.zh: 古老故事裡的先知預言會有一場大洪水。

examples.en: The prosecution presented new evidence in court.
examples.zh: 檢方在法庭上提出了新的證據。

examples.en: The prosecution of the case took several months.
examples.zh: 這個案件的起訴過程花了好幾個月。

examples.en: The lawyer for the prosecution asked the witness a question.
examples.zh: 檢方律師向證人提問。

senses.zh: 供應；條款；糧食儲備（用複數）

examples.en: The city is responsible for the provision of clean water.
examples.zh: 市政府負責供應乾淨的水。

examples.en: The contract has a provision for early payment.
examples.zh: 合約中有一項提前付款的條款。

examples.en: The hikers packed provisions for three days.
examples.zh: 登山客準備了三天份的糧食。

examples.en: Don't provoke the dog by pulling its tail.
examples.zh: 不要拉狗的尾巴去惹牠生氣。

examples.en: The speech provoked a lively discussion in class.
examples.zh: 這場演講在班上引起了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: Her joke provoked laughter from the whole room.
examples.zh: 她的笑話引得全場哄堂大笑。

examples.en: The nurse checked my pulse and my temperature.
examples.zh: 護理師檢查了我的脈搏和體溫。

examples.en: Your pulse gets faster when you run.
examples.zh: 跑步的時候，你的脈搏會變快。

examples.en: We could feel the pulse of the music through the floor.
examples.zh: 我們透過地板感受到音樂的節奏。

examples.en: Her heart pulsed with excitement before the game.
examples.zh: 比賽前她的心因興奮而怦怦跳動。

examples.en: Lights pulsed in time with the music.
examples.zh: 燈光隨著音樂節奏閃動。

examples.en: Blood pulses through the arteries with each beat of the heart.
examples.zh: 心臟每跳動一次，血液便在動脈中形成一次脈動。

senses.zh: 金字塔；角錐；金字塔形結構

examples.en: We learned how the ancient pyramid was built.
examples.zh: 我們學到古代金字塔是怎麼蓋成的。

examples.en: The students drew a pyramid in their geometry class.
examples.zh: 學生們在幾何課中畫了一個角錐。

examples.en: The cheerleaders formed a human pyramid during the halftime show.
examples.zh: 啦啦隊員在中場表演時疊出了一座人體金字塔。

examples.en: Her quest for the truth took many years.
examples.zh: 她追尋真相花了許多年。

examples.en: The hero set out on a quest to find the lost key.
examples.zh: 主角踏上尋找遺失鑰匙的旅程。

examples.en: In the game, you must finish each quest to level up.
examples.zh: 在這個遊戲中，你必須完成每個任務才能升級。

examples.en: Please fill out this questionnaire before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請填寫這份問卷。

examples.en: The school sent a questionnaire to every parent.
examples.zh: 學校寄了一份問卷給每位家長。

examples.en: The online questionnaire takes only five minutes.
examples.zh: 這份線上問卷只需要五分鐘。

examples.en: The little dog quivered with fear during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，小狗嚇得發抖。

examples.en: Her voice quivered when she began the speech.
examples.zh: 她開始演講時，聲音微微顫抖。

examples.en: The leaves quivered in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 樹葉在冷風中微微顫動。

examples.en: There was a quiver in his voice as he spoke.
examples.zh: 他說話的聲音有些顫抖。

examples.en: The archer pulled an arrow from her quiver.
examples.zh: 弓箭手從箭袋中抽出一支箭。

examples.en: A quiver of excitement ran through the crowd.
examples.zh: 一陣興奮的顫動傳遍人群。

examples.en: Each student has a quota of ten free prints a month.
examples.zh: 每位學生每個月有十張免費列印的額度。

examples.en: The factory reached its monthly sales quota.
examples.zh: 這間工廠達成了每月的銷售目標。

examples.en: The government set a quota on imported rice.
examples.zh: 政府對進口稻米設定了配額。
